evidence.title: Machine Learning Assisted Inverse Design of Pixelated mmWave Patch Antennas

summary: Researchers have applied machine-learning techniques to automate the inverse design of pixelated millimeter-wave patch antennas, drastically cutting design time while meeting target performance metrics. The method uses generative models to optimize antenna geometry for specific radiation characteristics, paving the way for faster prototyping in high-frequency communications.
title: Machine Learning Enables Inverse Design of Pixelated mmWave Patch Antennas
